note: Max rank only. The simulator runs at level 60, and a talent tooltip shows rank 1 of the ability it grants -- see docs/class-implementation.md.

spells.name: Amplify Magic
spells.description: Amplifies magic used against the targeted party member, increasing damage taken from spells by up to 113 and healing spells by up to 225. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Arcane Blast
spells.description: Blasts the target with energy, dealing 364 to 424 Arcane damage. Each time you cast Arcane Blast, the damage of all your other spells is increased by 10% and the mana cost of Arcane Blast is increased by 175%. Effect stacks up to 4 times and lasts 8 sec or until any other damage spell is cast.

spells.name: Arcane Brilliance
spells.description: Infuses the target's party and raid with brilliance, increasing their Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.

spells.name: Arcane Explosion
spells.description: Causes an explosion of arcane magic around the caster, causing 238 to 258 Arcane damage to all targets within 10 yards.

spells.name: Arcane Intellect
spells.description: Increases the target's Intellect by 31 for 1 hour.

spells.name: Arcane Missiles
spells.description: Launches Arcane Missiles at the enemy, causing 209 Arcane damage each second for 5 sec.

spells.name: Arcane Power
spells.description: For the next 15 sec, your spells deal 30% more damage while costing 30% more mana to cast.

spells.name: Blast Wave
spells.description: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, damaging all enemies caught within the blast for 453 to 533 Fire damage, and Dazing them for 50% reduced movement speed for 6 sec.

spells.name: Blink
spells.description: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way. Also frees the caster from Stuns and Immobilizes.

spells.name: Blizzard
spells.description: Ice shards pelt the target area doing 1,168 Frost damage over 8 sec.

spells.name: Cold Snap
spells.description: Finishes the remaining cooldown on all your other Frost spells.

spells.name: Combustion
spells.description: When activated, this spell causes each of your Fire damage spell hits to increase your critical strike chance with Fire damage spells by 10%. This effect lasts until you have caused 4 non-periodic critical strikes with Fire spells.

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.description: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take 328 to 358 Frost damage and are slowed by 40% for 6 sec.

spells.name: Conjure Food
spells.description:
Conjures 10 cinnamon rolls, providing the mage and his allies with something to eat.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spells.name: Conjure Mana Agate
spells.description:
Conjures a mana agate that can be used to instantly restore 375 to 425 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spells.name: Conjure Mana Citrine
spells.description:
Conjures a mana citrine that can be used to instantly restore 775 to 925 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spells.name: Conjure Mana Jade
spells.description:
Conjures a mana jade that can be used to instantly restore 550 to 650 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spells.name: Conjure Mana Ruby
spells.description:
Conjures a mana ruby that can be used to instantly restore 1,000 to 1,200 mana.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spells.name: Conjure Water
spells.description:
Conjures 10 bottles of crystal water, providing the mage and his allies with something to drink.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.description: Counters the enemy's spellcast, preventing any spell from that school of magic from being cast for 10 sec. Generates a high amount of threat.

spells.name: Dampen Magic
spells.description: Dampens magic used against the targeted party member, decreasing damage taken from spells by up to 135 and healing spells by up to 270. Lasts 10 min.

spells.name: Evocation
spells.description: While channeling this spell, your mana regeneration is active and increased by 1,500%. Lasts 8 sec.

spells.name: Fire Blast
spells.description: Blasts the enemy for 417 to 489 Fire damage.

spells.name: Fire Ward
spells.description: Absorbs 913 Fire damage. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: Hurls a fiery ball that causes 425 to 541 Fire damage and an additional 60 Fire damage over 8 sec.

spells.name: Flamestrike
spells.description: Calls down a pillar of fire, burning all enemies within the area for 381 to 465 Fire damage and an additional 332 Fire damage over 8 sec. Only one Flamestrike can be active per Mage at a time.

spells.name: Frost Armor
spells.description: Increases Armor by 200. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

spells.name: Frost Nova
spells.description: Blasts enemies near the caster for 71 to 79 Frost damage and freezes them in place for up to 8 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

spells.name: Frost Ward
spells.description: Absorbs 913 Frost damage. Lasts 30 sec.

spells.name: Frostbolt
spells.description: Launches a bolt of frost at the enemy, causing 457 to 493 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 40% for 9 sec.

spells.name: Frostfire Bolt
spells.description: Launches a bolt of frostfire at the enemy, causing 270 to 314 Frostfire damage, slowing movement speed by 40% and causing an additional 57 Frostfire damage over 9 sec. This spell will be checked against the lower of the target's Frost and Fire resists and counts as both Frost and Fire damage.

spells.name: Ice Armor
spells.description: Increases Armor by 560 and frost resistance by 15. If an enemy strikes the caster, they may have their movement slowed by 30% and the time between their attacks increased by 25% for 5 sec. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

spells.name: Ice Barrier
spells.description: Instantly shields you, absorbing 819 damage. Lasts 1 min. While the shield holds, your spellcasts will not be interrupted or delayed from taking damage.

spells.name: Ice Block
spells.description: You become encased in a block of ice, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but during that time you cannot attack, move, or cast spells.

spells.name: Ice Lance
spells.description: Deals 136 to 160 Frost damage to an enemy target. Deals 300% increased damage to Frozen targets.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.description: Increases your resistance to all magic by 15 and allows 50% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting. Only one type of Armor spell can be active on the Mage at any time. Lasts 30 min.

spells.name: Mana Shield
spells.description: Absorbs 570 physical damage, draining mana instead. Drains 2 mana per damage absorbed. Lasts 1 min.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.description: Transforms the enemy into a sheep, forcing it to wander around for up to 50 sec. While wandering, the sheep cannot attack or cast spells but will regenerate very quickly. Any damage will transform the target back into its normal form. Only one target can be polymorphed at a time. Only works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters.

spells.name: Portal: Darnassus
spells.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Darnassus.

spells.name: Portal: Ironforge
spells.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Ironforge.

spells.name: Portal: Orgrimmar
spells.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Orgrimmar.

spells.name: Portal: Stormwind
spells.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Stormwind.

spells.name: Portal: Thunder Bluff
spells.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Thunder Bluff.

spells.name: Portal: Undercity
spells.description: Creates a portal, teleporting group members that use it to Undercity.

spells.name: Presence of Mind
spells.description: When activated, your next Mage spell with a casting time less than 10 sec becomes an instant cast spell.

spells.name: Pyroblast
spells.description: Hurls an immense fiery boulder that causes 520 to 646 Fire damage and an additional 212 Fire damage over 12 sec.

spells.name: Remove Lesser Curse
spells.description: Removes 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.

spells.name: Scorch
spells.description: Scorch the enemy for 166 to 196 Fire damage.

spells.name: Slow Fall
spells.description: Slows falling speed for 30 sec.

spells.name: Teleport: Dalaran
spells.description: Teleports the caster to Dalaran.

spells.name: Teleport: Darnassus
spells.description: Teleports the caster to Darnassus.

spells.name: Teleport: Ironforge
spells.description: Teleports the caster to Ironforge.

spells.name: Teleport: Orgrimmar
spells.description: Teleports the caster to Orgrimmar.

spells.name: Teleport: Stormwind
spells.description: Teleports the caster to Stormwind.

spells.name: Teleport: Thunder Bluff
spells.description: Teleports the caster to Thunder Bluff.
